rules.name: cs-27-fx-group-weighted-20nov-cfs
rules.sql: WITH legs AS ( SELECT upper(split_part(cd.contract_number, '_', 1)) AS client, lower(cd.market_action) AS side, s.maturity_date AS value_date, cd.contract_number, cd.trade_id, cd.transaction_date, abs(cd.original_lots) AS lots, dt.premium AS price FROM opera.cloned_deal_ticket_table cd JOIN opera.cloned_security_info_table s ON s.tenant_id = cd.tenant_id AND s.business_unit = cd.business_unit AND s.security_id = cd.security_id LEFT JOIN (SELECT trade_id, max(premium) AS premium FROM opera.deal_ticket_table WHERE tenant_id = :tenant AND is_latest_version = 1 AND premium IS NOT NULL GROUP BY trade_id) dt ON dt.trade_id = cd.trade_id WHERE cd.tenant_id = :tenant AND upper(cd.business_unit) = 'CFS' AND cd.is_latest_version = 1 AND s.derivative_type LIKE 'fx_forward%' AND upper(split_part(cd.contract_number, '_', 1)) = ANY (string_to_array(:fxClients, ',')) ), g AS ( SELECT client, side, value_date, count(*) AS legs, sum(lots) AS nominal, sum(lots * price) / nullif(sum(lots), 0) AS wavg_exact, round((sum(lots * price) / nullif(sum(lots), 0))::numeric, 4) AS wavg_4dp, round((sum(lots * price) / nullif(sum(lots), 0))::numeric, 6) AS wavg_6dp, round((sum(lots * round(price::numeric, 4)) / nullif(sum(lots), 0))::numeric, 8) AS wavg_leg4_8dp, min(transaction_date) AS first_trade, max(transaction_date) AS last_trade FROM legs GROUP BY client, side, value_date ) SELECT * FROM g WHERE abs(nominal - 644537.48) < 0.5 OR abs(nominal - 98831.03) < 0.5 ORDER BY client, nominal

SELECT upper(split_part(cd.contract_number, '_', 1)) AS client, lower(cd.market_action) AS side, s.maturity_date AS value_date, cd.contract_number, cd.trade_id, cd.transaction_date, cd.original_lots, dt.premium::text AS price_text, cd.premium::text AS clone_price_text FROM opera.cloned_deal_ticket_table cd JOIN opera.cloned_security_info_table s ON s.tenant_id = cd.tenant_id AND s.business_unit = cd.business_unit AND s.security_id = cd.security_id LEFT JOIN (SELECT trade_id, max(premium) AS premium FROM opera.deal_ticket_table WHERE tenant_id = :tenant AND is_latest_version = 1 AND premium IS NOT NULL GROUP BY trade_id) dt ON dt.trade_id = cd.trade_id WHERE cd.tenant_id = :tenant AND upper(cd.business_unit) = 'CFS' AND cd.is_latest_version = 1 AND s.derivative_type LIKE 'fx_forward%' AND upper(split_part(cd.contract_number, '_', 1)) = ANY (string_to_array(:fxClients, ',')) AND cd.transaction_date >= DATE '2026-11-05' ORDER BY client, value_date, cd.contract_number
